objectpackh6memorialRumor0.text: They say the H6 Memorial Advanced Magic Academy will even teach the secret arts of the magic classes — but only once you have trained a school skill to Expert.

objectpackh6memorialRumor1.text: A mage says you can visit the H6 Memorial Magic Academy again and again: each time your school skill goes up a level, you can go back and learn spells of one tier higher.

objectpackh6memorialRumor2.text: They say the H6 Memorial Shrine only recognizes an army with all seven tiers from a single faction, and a hero who gathers one can use Battle Cries even without a spellbook.

objectpackh6memorialRumor3.text: Veterans of the Sanctuary say that once a hero has learned Jinx at the Memorial Shrine, enemies are left frozen or dazed the moment battle begins.
